read.thesis: Nike Q1 FY25 revenue fell 10% with full-year guidance withdrawn; Q2 revenue guided down 8-10% and gross margin down ~150bp, with inventory slightly elevated and no supply-side capacity cuts disclosed.

triggers.label: Full-year guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: we are withdrawing our full year guidance. We intend to provide quarterly guidance for the balance of the fiscal year.

triggers.label: Marketplace inventory slightly elevated
triggers.quote: we are seeing slightly elevated inventory as a result of the retail sales plans falling behind

triggers.label: Spring '25 order books flat
triggers.quote: our order books came in, on with our partners at flat versus the prior year. And it was a little light relative to what we expected.

triggers.label: Q2 gross margin down ~150bp
triggers.quote: We expect Q2 gross margins to be down approximately 150 basis points, with higher promotions, channel mix headwinds

triggers.label: New footwear revenue up strong double-digits
triggers.quote: Q1 revenue from new footwear products was up strong double-digits versus the prior year.

triggers.label: Running footwear back to positive growth
triggers.quote: men's and women's running footwear delivered positive growth in Q1, a meaningful improvement versus the prior quarter.

guidance.quote: We expect Q2 revenues to be down in the 8% to 10% range.
We expect Q2 gross margins to be down approximately 150 basis points
We expect SG&A to be roughly flat versus the prior year
We expect other income and expense, including net interest income to be $30 million to $40 million
we expect our effective tax rate to be in the high-teens range.

guidance.value: mid-single digit headwind on revenue for balance of year
guidance.quote: a mid-single digit headwind on revenue for the balance of this year

red_flags.label: Full-year guidance withdrawn amid CEO transition
red_flags.quote: we are withdrawing our full year guidance

red_flags.label: Inventory elevated, promotions rising
red_flags.quote: we are seeing slightly elevated inventory as a result of the retail sales plans falling behind

red_flags.label: China traffic and sell-through weakening
red_flags.quote: This has resulted in elevated inventory in the marketplace in an already promotional environment.

evasions.quote: It doesn't specifically relate to just the classics.
we've acknowledged that we've lost market share in the Running specialty channel.
